title: Document Learning Pipeline (PDFs, Notes, Articles, Academic Studies)
brief: Extend knowledge extraction to text documents: PDF/markdown/text ingestion, document classification, adapted prompts, schema extension, MCP integration with upload + query routes.

phases.title: Document Learning Pipeline
phases.description: Build end-to-end document ingestion and knowledge extraction pipeline. Extend knowledge schema for document provenance, create document-specific prompts, add MCP tools for document upload and querying.

units.title: Document Text Extraction Module
exit_conditions: document_ingest.py extracts text from PDF, markdown, plain text, and HTML
PDF extraction handles multi-page documents with page-level provenance
Metadata extraction (title, author, date, DOI) works for academic PDFs
Tests pass for all 4 document formats

steps.instruction: Install PDF extraction dependencies (pypdf or pdfplumber). Add to requirements.txt.
Create cad-engine/src/document_ingest.py with DocumentIngestResult dataclass and ingest_document() function supporting PDF, markdown, plain text, HTML formats.
Implement PDF text extraction with page-level chunking and metadata extraction (title from PDF metadata, author, creation date, DOI detection via regex).
Implement markdown/plaintext/HTML text extraction (markdown-it for HTML stripping, frontmatter parsing for metadata).
Create tests/test_document_ingest.py with test fixtures and tests for all 4 formats.
Run pytest, verify all tests pass.

units.description: Document Text Extraction Module — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Document Type Classifier
exit_conditions: document_classify.py classifies documents into: academic_paper, technical_manual, handbook, blog_article, notes, specification, other
Classification uses structural cues (abstract, references, DOI) + content keywords
Returns document type + confidence + evidence
Tests pass

steps.instruction: Create cad-engine/src/document_classify.py with DocumentType enum and classify_document() function.

Implement keyword-based + structural classification: academic papers (abstract, references, DOI, methodology), manuals (table of contents, chapters), handbooks (procedures, tables), blogs (informal tone, short), notes (bullet points, fragments), specs (shall/must language, requirement numbering).
Add tests for each document type classification.
Run pytest, verify all tests pass.

units.description: Document Type Classifier — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Document-Specific Extraction Prompts
exit_conditions: document_prompts.py has system prompts adapted for text documents (not videos)
Document type-specific context prompts exist (academic, manual, handbook, etc.)
Prompts instruct extraction of page-level provenance instead of timestamps
build_document_user_message() constructs evidence from extracted text + metadata
Tests pass

steps.instruction: Create cad-engine/src/prompts/document_prompts.py with DOCUMENT_CAD_SYSTEM_PROMPT, DOCUMENT_CAM_SYSTEM_PROMPT, DOCUMENT_SHOP_SYSTEM_PROMPT adapted for reading documents instead of watching videos.
Add document type-specific context prompts: academic paper (cite methodology, results), manual (extract procedures, specs), handbook (extract best practices), blog (extract tips, experiences).
Implement get_document_prompt(domain, doc_type) and build_document_user_message(text, metadata, doc_type) with page-level chunking for large documents.
Add tests for prompt selection and message building.
Run pytest, verify all tests pass.

units.description: Document-Specific Extraction Prompts — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Schema Extension for Document Provenance
exit_conditions: Schema extended with document_metadata (author, publication, DOI, page_count, format)
Provenance extended with page_number and section_title fields
source_type enum includes 'document' alongside transcript/vision/ocr/inferred
Backward compatible — existing video knowledge docs still validate
Tests pass

steps.instruction: Extend knowledge_schema_v2.json: add document_metadata definition (author, publication_title, publication_date, doi, page_count, format, url).
Extend provenance definition: add optional page_number (integer) and section_title (string) fields. Add 'document' to source_type enum.
Add metadata.source_type field to distinguish video vs document origins.
Verify existing tests still pass (backward compatibility).
Add schema validation tests for new document fields.

deliverables.description: Extended knowledge schema with document provenance

units.description: Schema Extension for Document Provenance — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Document Extraction Orchestrator
entry_conditions: document_ingest.py, document_classify.py, document_prompts.py, schema v2 extended
exit_conditions: document_extract.py orchestrates: ingest → classify → domain-detect → extract → validate → link → store
Handles multi-domain documents (extracts CAD + CAM + SHOP from single document)
Large document chunking (splits PDFs > 20 pages into overlapping chunks)
Deduplicates extracted items across chunks
Tests pass with mocked API

steps.instruction: Create cad-engine/src/document_extract.py with extract_from_document() orchestrator. Reuse existing _extract_cad/cam/shop from knowledge_extract.py but with document prompts.
Implement chunking strategy for large documents: split by page boundaries, overlap 1 page, max 15 pages per chunk.
Implement deduplication: merge items with same ID or >80% title similarity across chunks.
Wire domain classification from document_classify.py into extraction flow.
Create comprehensive tests with mocked API responses for PDF, markdown, and multi-domain documents.
Run full test suite, verify no regressions.

units.description: Document Extraction Orchestrator — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP Document Upload Tool
exit_conditions: New MCP tool prism_learn_document with actions: upload, extract, list, get, delete
Upload accepts file path or URL, triggers extraction pipeline
Extract returns structured knowledge with validation results
List/get/delete manage stored document knowledge
Build passes, tests pass

steps.instruction: Create mcp-server/src/tools/dispatchers/documentLearningDispatcher.ts with 5 actions: upload, extract, list, get, delete.
Implement upload action: accept file_path, detect format, call Python cad-engine document_extract.py via child_process.
Implement extract action: run extraction on uploaded document, return results.
Implement list/get/delete actions for managing stored document knowledge.
Register dispatcher in dispatcher index. Add to MASTER_INDEX.
Add tests, run build + test suite.
